// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-BANNED-IDENTIFIER
// @expect: OPS-MUTATION-MODULE
// The exact shape the operations module is allowed, written in the read
// chokepoint. The permission is confined to one file so the shape cannot be
// copied into a screen, an action or a second helper: a mutation nobody put on
// the registry is not an operation, it is a function somebody added.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { makeFamilyCode } from "@/lib/familyCodeMint";

export async function rotate(parentId) {
  await db.parent.update({
    where: { id: parentId },
    data: { familyCode: makeFamilyCode() },
    select: { id: true },
  });
}
